cmd.pidsymbol.help: Place P&ID symbols: valves, equipment, instruments, in-line items and connectors. An in-line symbol clicked on a process line cuts the line either side of it.
cmd.pidline.help: Draw a process line or a signal line (pneumatic, electric, software, capillary). A process line carries a line number built from its size, service, sequence and spec.
cmd.pidtag.help: Give a symbol its tag and description, or tag every untagged piece of equipment at once (A).
cmd.pidln.help: Set the size, service and spec of process lines, and number them.
cmd.pidlist.help: Put the line list, equipment list, instrument index or valve list on the sheet as a table that stays up to date.
cmd.pidcheck.help: Check the diagram for untagged items, duplicate tags, open line ends and more, and zoom to each one.
ask.tag.inst: Instrument tag: letters (FIC) or letters and number (FIC-101)
ask.line.next: Next corner of the {style} (Enter to finish)
ask.match: Click the line whose number to use
ask.pidln: Click a line to set (service {svc}, size {size}, spec {spec}; new number each: {next})
ask.table: Corner of the table (Enter to skip)
ask.check.zoom: Number to zoom to (1 to {n}, Enter to finish)
done.autotag.skipped: {n} instruments need their letters: tag them one by one.
done.table: The list is on the sheet and stays up to date.
err.empty: There is no P&ID in this drawing yet.
err.line: That line has too few points.
err.notline: No process or signal line there.
warn.maxpts: A line holds at most 100 points.
check.no-line-number: A process line has no line number.
check.ln-changes: Line {a} runs into line {b} with nothing between them: add a reducer or a spec break.
prop.lbl: Write the number on this piece
proc.err.file: That file is not a CadCraft process model.
proc.err.none: This drawing has no process model yet. Open one with IMPORT, or have the assistant build a plant.
proc.err.noinst: There are no tagged instruments or valves to export.
proc.done.run: {units} units and {streams} streams; {linked} newly linked to this drawing. {errors} errors, {warnings} warnings.
proc.done.size: {ln} is now {size}: {n} line pieces updated; velocity {v} m/s, drop {dp} bar.
cmd.pidproc.help: Link the drawing to the process model, run it, draw its stream table, change a line size and carry it through, or list the control system lines.
ctl.io: Channels: {ai} analog in, {ao} analog out, {di} digital in, {do} digital out (before spares).
ctl.noloops: No loops with two or more devices were found among the tags.
import.dexpi.empty: {name} holds no equipment, valves or lines this P&ID has symbols for.
import.streams.none: No stream table was found in {name}.
cmd.pidcalc.help: Run a process calculator (flash, flowsheet, exchanger, vessel, network, pipe stress, relief, HAZOP, LOPA, consequence and more) and see its results and Problems.
calc.lede: Pick a calculator, edit the sample input, and run it. A calculation aid, not an engineering approval: typed constants are marked for review.
calc.badjson: The input is not valid JSON: {why}
cmd.pidzone.help: Draw the hazardous-area zones from the area calculator on the sheet: plan circles, or a section through the release. Layers AREA-ZONE0, AREA-ZONE1 and AREA-ZONE2. A screening result, not an engineering approval.
zone.none: No zones to draw: run the area calculator first and check its Problems.
cmd.pidhazop.help: Review the HAZOP rows your assistant suggested: accept or reject them by name. The assistant never accepts a row itself.
hazop.none: There is no HAZOP worksheet yet: draw some equipment and tags, or let your assistant propose nodes from this P&ID.
hazop.head: HAZOP worksheet: {nodes} nodes, {rows} rows, {open} waiting for the team.
hazop.ask: Accept (A), reject (R) or Enter to leave them
hazop.ids: Which rows (ids such as R1 R2, or all)
hazop.nowho: A decision needs a name. Nothing changed.
feeds.none: No stream table has been imported in this session. Use Import › Stream table (CSV or Excel) first.
feeds.done: {n} feed(s) of the process model set from {name}; {skipped} stream(s) not applied.
cmd.pidfeeds.help: Set the process model's feeds from the stream table you imported (Import › Stream table)
sketch.lede: Draw a structure: click to place an atom (it joins the one marked), click two atoms to join them, click a bond's two atoms again for a double or triple bond. Right-click ends a chain.
sketch.hint: Click the drawing area to place the first atom.
sketch.ringhint: Click an empty spot to place the ring.
wire.in: Line {ln} is {size} in 3D. The P&ID took it ({n} line pieces changed).
wire.in.model: A process model arrived ({name}); {n} line pieces changed.
wire.out: The size was sent to the 3D model.
cmd.pidsources.help: Read the release sources from the drawing's equipment and fittings, classify them with the area calculator's pack and keep the zones for PIDZONE. A screening result, not an engineering approval; not engineer-reviewed.
cmd.pidconseq.help: Draw the zones of the consequence calculator on the sheet (radiation, blast or plume footprints) on layers CONSEQ-1, CONSEQ-2 … A screening result; not engineer-reviewed.
cmd.pidrelief.help: Size a relief valve of the drawing with the relief calculator's inputs and write its orifice letter and area on the symbol. Not engineer-reviewed.
src.ask: Substance of each service, as JSON: {"service":{"name","lfl","M"}}
src.done: {n} zones from {items} items of the drawing. Run PIDZONE to draw them.
relief.none: No relief valve in the drawing.
cmd.pidpfd.help: Draw the process flow diagram of the process model: units in columns by flow, streams with their names, temperature and pressure, recycles over the top, and the stream table under it.
cmd.pidhen.help: Draw the heat-exchanger network grid from stream data (pinch design): hot streams on top, cold below, the pinch line, matches with their duties, heaters and coolers.
cmd.pidnode.help: Draw a HAZOP node boundary with two corners. The equipment tags and line numbers inside it fill the node, and it is saved with the drawing.
cmd.pidlive.help: Put the plant's values beside the tagged symbols, coloured by state: from a historian CSV (tag,time,value,quality) or from Studio's plant connection. Read only.
cmd.pidtubesheet.help: Draw the tube sheet of an exchanger from the exchanger calculator's input: the shell, every tube, the pass lane.
cmd.pidplume.help: Draw the plume contours of the stack in the air calculator on the sheet, with the stack, the wind arrow and a note that this is a screening, not a permit model.
pfd.ask: Lower left corner of the diagram (Enter to cancel)
pfd.nosolve: The flowsheet did not solve ({why}); the diagram is drawn without temperatures and pressures.
pfd.done: Process flow diagram of {units} units drawn ({n} items) with its stream table.
hen.ask.streams: Stream data as JSON [{Ts, Tt, CP}…] (CP in kW/K, one temperature scale)
hen.badjson: The stream data is not valid JSON.
hen.ask.at: Upper left corner of the grid (Enter to cancel)
hen.done: Grid drawn: {matches} matches, {heaters} heaters, {coolers} coolers, {units} units against a minimum of {min} ({n} items).
node.ask.a: First corner of the node (Enter to cancel)
node.ask.name: Node name
node.done: Node {id} {name}: {tags} tagged items and {lines} lines inside. Saved with the drawing.
live.notags: No tagged symbols on the sheet to put values beside.
live.ask.csv: Readings as CSV with a header row tag,time,value,quality (use \n for line breaks), or Enter to read Studio's plant connection
live.needs: Give the readings as CSV, or open this drawing in CadCraft Studio and allow its plant connection. The browser alone cannot read a plant.
live.done: {n} value labels drawn, {missing} tags without a symbol, {problems} notes in Problems.
plume.done: Plume drawn: {contours} contours ({n} items). A screening, not AERMOD.
loops.lede: Tie each controller of the drawing to what it reads and drives in the plant model, run it, and work the faceplates. A model, not a plant.
loops.spec: Plant model (JSON: tanks, reactors, valves, sources)
loops.none: No loops with a controller on this drawing yet.
loops.nobound: No controller is tied to a measurement and an output yet.
pfd.notable: The stream table could not be added: {why}
live.lede: Show readings from a plant or a building on the drawing. Read only: nothing here writes to a device or raises an alarm. A device on a public address needs your yes for that host.
live.check.done: {tags} tags on {devices} devices checked: {problems} things to look at.
live.bridge.none: Reading a device needs CadCraft Studio: a browser page cannot open a plant network connection. Use a CSV of readings meanwhile.
live.bridge.noproto: This Studio does not read {protocol} yet.
live.note: Read-only plant and building data, for viewing and comparison. Not an alarm system or a safety function.
timer.lede: Keep the HAZOP session on time. Set the minutes for each node, start the clock on the node the team is discussing, and move on when it is done. Over-time is shown, never forced.
timer.none: No node yet. Draw a node boundary with PIDNODE first.
timer.note: A team study aid. It records the time; it does not decide that a node is finished.
calc.option.pick: Choose a fitting from the draft table…
